title: Renewals
description:
MongoDB is looking for a driven and results-oriented Renewal Specialist to join our Renewals Team in the Americas region. As a founding member of the Renewal Team in this region, you will play a key role in the build out of a world class renewal experience for our MongoDB customers, delivering strong business impact to MongoDB as well.

You will be working directly with our customers to renew their MongoDB contracts owning the renewal process from 120 days prior to renewal expiration. Given this is a new team at MongoDB you will contribute to developing our renewal process and playbooks to delight customers and deliver strong renewal results.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication and Interpersonal skills, operational excellence, deal formulation and negotiation experience, a strong aptitude to learn MongoDB products and policy and solid relations with internal stakeholders. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast paced and ever changing environment and who is motivated by the opportunity to have a big impact on your team, customers and MongoDB’s business.

What you will be doing
  • Renewal Management: Proactively manage the end-to-end renewal process for assigned customer accounts, ultimately increasing the Renewal Rate.
  • Work on upcoming renewals and engage with customers 120 days in advance to secure timely renewals.
  • Prepare renewal quotes and contracts, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their usage, needs and challenges; act as a trusted advisor to customers, providing insights and solutions to maximize the value they receive from MongoDB.
  • Collaborate with customers to address any objections or concerns related to renewals; negotiate contract terms and pricing to achieve win-win agreements.
  • Utilize data and reporting tools to track renewal performance, forecast renewals, and identify at-risk accounts; provide regular updates to the management team on renewal status and key metrics.
  • Work closely with the sales, customer success, and other stakeholders internally to ensure a coordinated approach to renewals.
We’re looking for someone with:
  • 3+ years of quota-carrying experience in a fast-paced and competitive market with a focus on closing Renewals.
  • Bachelor's/Master’s degree in engineering or business.
  • A proven track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present to a diverse audience, both internally and externally.
  • Strong problem-solving, organization and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple opportunities to be managed at the same time.
  • Talent for building solid relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Driven and competitive. Possess a strong desire to be successful.
  • Prior exposure to database, cloud and infrastructure technology is a plus.
  • Fluent in French & English is required, plus additional languages would be an advantage.
Things we love
  • Passionate about growing your career in the largest market in software (database).
  • Familiarity with databases, develops and open source technology a plus.
Why join now
  • MongoDB invests heavily in the development of each of our new hires & continuous career development.
  • Best in breed Sales trainings, including our comprehensive Sales Bootcamps and development programs.
  • Generous and competitive benefits (parental leave, fertility & wellbeing support).
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture - Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB.
About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: MÉDICO - NEURO INFANTIL
description:
Principais Atividades

  • Evoluir os pacientes em seu plantão, examinando-os, prescrevendo-os e ministrando tratamentos para as diversas patologias, aplicando métodos da medicina aceitos e reconhecidos cientificamente, seguindo o Plano Terapêutico definido;

  • Registrar em prontuário do paciente, o diagnóstico, tratamento e evolução da doença;

  • Emitir atestados diversos, laudos e pareceres, para atender a determinações legais;

  • Desenvolver ações de saúde coletiva e participar de processos de vigilância em saúde, visando garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desempenhar suas atividades, respeitando os princípios do Código de Ética Médica e cumprindo as normas de trabalho designadas pelo regulamento interno do hospital;

  • Prestar cuidados ao paciente de acordo com a respectiva especialidade (cirurgião geral, clínica médica, neonatologia, obstetrícia, ortopedia, pediatria, psiquiatria, UCI, UTI adulto, UTI pediátrica) respeitando as orientações do médico assistente (Plano Terapêutico), e comunicar este sobre modificações importantes no quadro evolutivo do mesmo;

  • Prestar atendimento de urgência e emergência a todo paciente admitido nestas condições na unidade de Pronto Atendimento;

  • Prestar informações médicas ao paciente ou responsável legal, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário, em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);

  • Prestar informações médicas aos acompanhantes e familiares, sempre com autorização do paciente, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário registrando em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);

  • Efetuar o planejamento das admissões e altas (Plano Terapêutico) em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional e supervisionar os cuidados clínicos efetuados na unidade;

  • Admitir os pacientes na unidade, solicitando os documentos necessários e efetuando os devidos registros e controles internos, bem como programar e realizar as altas da unidade;

  • Examinar, evoluir e prescrever os pacientes (do pronto atendimento, da recuperação pós-anestésica do centro cirúrgico, do centro obstétrico ou da enfermaria), checando exames e alterações fisiológicas e definindo condutas em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional, médico assistente e família/paciente;

  • Atender avaliações de urgência e emergência em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, o mais breve possível, registrando suas condutas e observações adequadamente, no prontuário médico do paciente;

  • Atender interconsultas em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário medico do paciente;

  • Avaliar as solicitações de avaliação médica solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário médico do paciente;

  • Solicitar vaga externa através da Central de Regulação de Vagas, sempre que o hospital não dispuser de vaga ou de serviço necessário. Nestes casos, informar seu coordenador;

  • Informar ao coordenador da equipe os casos com evolução prolongada, intercorrências não esperadas ou intercorrências sociais que ocorram durante o seu plantão;

  • Detectar e comunicar os órgãos competentes a existência de doadores, doenças de notificação compulsória e/ou casos de violência;

  • Participar de programas de qualidade da unidade, incluindo coleta de informações;

  • Participar de reuniões clínicas e administrativas para promover o aperfeiçoamento do serviço, bem como de eventos externo-internos, quando solicitado;

  • Colaborar a participar na implementação de protocolos de assistência, pesquisa e ensino;

  • Interagir com os demais departamentos da instituição e áreas envolvidas no atendimento ao paciente, buscando o aprimoramento técnico e troca de experiências para melhoria constante das atividades da área;

  • Responder as solicitações do Serviço de Atenção ao Usuário referente à sua especialidade e atendimento;

  • Colaborar e participar do gerenciamento de risco da instituição;

  • Manter ao coordenador da unidade e da equipe informada sobre as atividades e problemas sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina;

  • Registro no Conselho ativo (CRM);

  • Conhecimento em informática - nível usuário.


Informações adicionais

  • Vale Refeição

  • Vale transporte

  • Vale alimentação

  • 20 horas semanais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira, MS Project, Trello, Monday, entre outros);
  • Capacidade de elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamentos e indicadores;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos, com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, CX);
  • Experiência em projetos de tecnologia e transformação digital.
O que você vai encontrar por aqui:
  • Flexibilidade nos seus horários;
  • Estacionamento para bikes e patinetes (em caso de ida ao escritório);
  • Oportunidades de crescimento cross brands;

  • Plano de saúde para o seu pet;
Além disso, incluímos também alguns benefícios com o propósito Mutant:
  • Liberdade para ser quem você é. Incluir todos com o mesmo olhar está em nosso DNA. Aqui não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, credo ou cor! Somos todos Mutants!
  • Pessoas e experiências são o que nos movem. São a nossa essência e nosso propósito. Ações e programas voltados a clima, desenvolvimento e cultura;
  • Gerar valor para pessoas e negócios. Juntos, criamos produtos digitais que impulsionam os negócios.;
  • Fazer parte de um time sensacional, que joga junto, com uma cultura de colaboração, inovação e transformação. E o mais importante: que se diverte em toda a jornada;
  • Trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários. As melhores cabeças do mercado em um lugar que elas podem ser elas mesmas: é assim que entregamos soluções disruptivas;
Valores e Cultura:

Nosso propósito é simples: evoluir a relação entre marcas e pessoas usando tecnologia, dados e criatividade.

Acreditamos na transparência das relações, na valorização das conquistas e não abrimos mão dos valores que nos trouxeram até aqui. O que é preciso para criar um mundo extraordinário?

Mais do que casas, queremos construir respostas. Já somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos, engajados na busca por um futuro melhor para todos e todas.

Acreditamos que diversidade e inclusão são componentes essenciais para o crescimento da sociedade, além de serem fatores essenciais para a sustentabilidade do nosso negócio. title: Drill and Blast Superintendent
description:
We are looking for an experienced Drill and Blast Superintendent to support the Mine Operations Department. In this crucial leadership role, you will provide strategic, technical, and operational guidance for all drill and blast activities. You will be responsible for planning and managing all operations within the drilling, blasting, and emulsion plant while ensuring that best in industry practices are followed.

Drilling & Blasting Operation Planning and Management

  • Lead drill and blast planning and scheduling in line with the short-range mine plan.

  • Prepare, verify, and approve drill and blast designs, including tie-up plans.

  • Lead cost-reduction and productivity improvement initiatives through new techniques, products, and optimization opportunities.

  • Drive continuous improvement in wall control blasting to support safe mining of steeper pit walls.

  • Provide technical expertise for the trial, implementation, and optimization of drill GPS technology.

  • Develop and implement safe work procedures, standards of practice, and operational quality control programs.

Operational Leadership, Technical Expertise & Team Development

  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and coaching to direct reports, ensuring they are equipped with the right skills, resources, and engineering controls.

  • Motivate the Drill & Blast team to maximise production efficiency and reduce operational variability.

  • Promote a strong safety culture by actively participating in our safety programs and maintaining Zero Harm principles.

  • Ensure drills, blasting equipment, and emulsion plant operations follow industry standards and SOPs.

  • Participate in short- and long-range mining production planning discussions.

Reporting, Budgeting & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Lead preparation of monthly drill and blast reports and assist in budget preparation and forecasting.

  • Oversee weekly drill and blast plans in coordination with senior mining engineers.

  • Monitor production reports to verify output quality, accuracy, and adherence to plan.

  • Communicate regularly and effectively with other departments to support integrated mine planning and operational success.

  • Attend and contribute actively to planning, safety, and production meetings.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will have:

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or equivalent.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in hard-rock drilling and blasting operations.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience managing multi-pit mining environments and resource planning.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience with DTH rigs and RC grade-control drilling operations.

  • Common Core Certification & holder of all required blasting tickets.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to work on a rotational schedule of 6 weeks on/ 3 weeks off.

Technical Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of mine design and planning software (preferably Gemcom GEMS ).

  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office , including Access.

  • Expertise in drill pattern design, blast tie-ups, wall control blasting, and explosives management.

  • Strong capability in developing SOPs, quality control frameworks, and safety improvement programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive, effective working relationships.

  • Proven ability to drive operational improvements and execute plans with high accountability.

If you are a motivated and experienced professional looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Please note that only candidates who meet these requirements will be considered for the drill and blast superintendent role at Rosebel Gold Mines.

title: Principal Consultant - Forest
description:
Job Description

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new‑generation energy markets. Fastmarkets is a global business with more than 700 employees across the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland and beyond.

This is an exciting opportunity for a candidate eager to help leading companies and market participants by delivering custom consulting engagements that enable our clients to thrive in volatile commodity markets.

The Role

The Principal Consultant will focus on leading and delivering custom consulting and research projects that span the forest products industry, including timber, wood products, pulp, paper, packaging and tissue. You will lead and deliver projects that include tailored market overviews and outlooks, assessments and analysis supporting financing and financial due diligence, feedstock analysis, industry cost modelling, supply‑chain mapping and other bespoke engagements.

You will be joining a dynamic global team dedicated to analysing and forecasting the forest products industry. You will leverage Fastmarkets’ existing data, insights and analyst team as an integral component of our consulting delivery. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast‑paced and innovative environment, have a can‑do attitude and juggle a wide variety of tasks and projects.

Responsibilities
  • Winning, executing, and project managing a range of commodity‑related market consultancy projects across forest products markets
  • Leading the delivery of consultancy projects with a strong onus on meeting client requirements, expectations and deadlines utilizing modelling, data collection, and research interview techniques
  • Developing and delivering compelling and impactful high‑quality deliverables that are robust, accurate, and well‑researched
  • Customizing house forecasts and cost models, including supply, demand, capacity, cost, and other critical metrics
  • Partnering with our sales teams to develop and support strategies to drive the commercial success of the consulting practice
  • Developing and building existing customer relationships and acquiring new consultancy customers, as well as repeat business
  • Creating customized pitch decks and proposals utilizing strong technical knowledge of the commodity markets
  • Participating in events and sales/marketing activities with a focus on existing and potential client business opportunities
  • Utilizing professional network to source independent contractors to support delivery of engagements
Qualifications

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open‑minded, curious, resilient, solutions‑oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

Knowledge, Experience and Skills
  • 10+ years of consulting experience in forest products commodities research and analysis, including timber, pulp, paper, packaging and/or timber
  • Ability and experience in managing, conducting, and researching commodity market studies both self‑sufficiently, as well as with members of a team often not located in the same office
  • Strong acumen and desire for business development is essential
  • Experience in complex solution selling and project execution/management involving single‑client consultancy services work
  • Experience in project and client relationship management across varying customer profiles
  • Strong commercial focus with good understanding from working with stakeholders at C‑level
  • Fluent in English, a second language preferred
  • Effective communication in person, online, and in writing (Word and PowerPoint)
  • Flexibility and willingness to travel when required
  • An already established client and industry contact network is desirable
  • Self‑starter and ‘hunter’ mentality with strong personal drive is essential, with the ability to thrive in a multitasking environment
  • Accountable and performance‑driven
  • Effective and amiable team player keen on making clients, project members, and colleagues happy while achieving ambitious objectives

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Additional Information Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer‑centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Apply Now

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day. It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

With us, you will embark on a personal growth journey and are encouraged to realize your potential. This is your invitation to rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 03/15/2026

Introdução

Estamos buscando por Técnico(a) Laboratório Pl para se juntar à nossa equipe de Processos de Laboratório. Você será responsável por executar atividades de caráter técnico, como ensaios, visando métodos adequados para o processo de análises, cumprir prazos previamente acordados ao trabalho, identificar e propor soluções a problemas oriundos de processos e análises. Você desempenhará um papel crucial para o sucesso do nosso negócio.

Nesta posição, você se reportará ao Coordenador de Processos.

Esta posição está localizada principalmente em Sorocaba e não envolve viagens.

Equipe a qual você pertence

Você se juntará a uma equipe de Laboratório dedicada a realização de ensaios, análises e métodos.

Atualmente estamos trabalhando na modernização do Laboratório com ampliação do portfólio de análises e com novos equipamentos para dar suporte e atuar como apoio para a fábrica.

Trabalhamos em estreita colaboração no dia a dia com partes interessadas internas/externas, como Industrial, Qualidade, Engenharia e Suprimentos.

A cultura da nossa equipe gira em torno de cliente no centro, grande ambição - sempre, fazendo o que deve ser feito – juntos e abertos e sinceros.

Os membros da nossa equipe estão localizados em Sorocaba.

O que você fará
  • Executar ensaios diversos de metal (análises químicas por espectrometria, FRX, combustão; ensaios mecânicos como impacto, dureza e microdureza; metalografias por microscopia de bancada e campo, réplica; radioatividade);
  • Executar ensaios diversos de areia (finos, resistência, carbono, etc);
  • Executar ensaios diversos de óleo (quenchímetro, Karl Fischer, viscosidade, crepitação, etc);
  • Executar ensaios de tribologia (desgaste);
  • Executar ensaios diversos que possam ser atribuídos ao Laboratório;
  • Executar atividades de preparação de amostras (cortes, quebras, lixamento, polimento, etc);
  • Participar e contribuir em reuniões de segurança, meio ambiente e ergonomia;
  • Desenvolvimento de fornecedores e clientes para novos processos, produtos e mercados com foco nas análises laboratoriais;
  • Elaboração e revisão dos procedimentos operacionais da área de Laboratório;
  • Aplicação de procedimentos técnicos nas áreas da Fundição, como Aciaria, Tratamento Térmico, Metalografia, Moldagem e Solda;
  • Realização da análise de falhas e emissão de relatórios.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos em geral.
Quem é você
  • Experiência em ensaios gerais de metalurgia, metalografia e análise de óleos;
  • Técnico Completo em Metalurgia, Química ou Materiais;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade de horários;
  • Residir em Sorocaba ou Votorantim;
  • Inglês intermediário será um diferencial;
  • Desejável experiência com Power BI.
O que oferecemos
  • Um propósito inspirador – Possibilitar uma vida moderna sustentável. Minerais e metais são a espinha dorsal de funções essenciais no mundo moderno. No entanto, há uma necessidade de soluções mais sustentáveis para os coletar e processar. Na Metso, você participa da transformação da indústria e de uma mudança positiva.
  • Ambiente de trabalho seguro – Para a Metso, segurança é um valor fundamental. Nosso objetivo é demonstrar liderança e visão na promoção da cultura de segurança.
  • Bem-estar – Nossos serviços de saúde ocupacional, associados às ações voltadas para a promoção de saúde e bem-estar demonstram nossa preocupação com a qualidade de vida e engajamento das pessoas.
  • Remuneração e benefícios – Estrutura de remuneração e benefícios alinhada às práticas de mercado, oferecendo um pacote atrativo através de uma composição equilibrada que contém remuneração fixa e variável, além de assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida, previdência privada, alimentação, entre outros, segundo políticas vigentes.
  • Flexibilidade – Defendemos as interações pessoais e a colaboração presencial associadas a um ambiente de trabalho aberto e flexível, valorizando o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Uma cultura próspera - Estamos empenhados em desenvolver uma cultura inclusiva que permita a todos dar o seu melhor e atingir o seu pleno potencial. Uma cultura que é corajosa, convincente e atenciosa, e que nos une para construirmos juntos um futuro sustentável.

title: Director
description:
Why Join Us?

Be a hero for our rare disease patients. At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. To achieve this goal, our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us, this means going where other biopharma companies won’t go – challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science, applying a novel rapid development approach, making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices, and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them. Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work. If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team.

Position Summary

Ultra focused – Work together to fearlessly uncover new possibilities.

Ultragenyx is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Director, Regulatory Affairs Brazil who is a team player and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. The Director will be responsible for developing key regulatory strategies and lead the execution of submissions in Brazil while monitoring and assessing applicable regulations including Gene Therapy guidance and regulation changes. The Director will work closely with regional and global regulatory colleagues, functional areas, and project teams to support regulatory activities in Brazil as a key market in the Latin America region. The Director, Regulatory Affairs Brazil will be based in Sao Paulo, Brazil with a hybrid model requiring some office-days. The position will report to the Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs LATAM.

Work Model

Flex: This role will typically require onsite work 2‑3 days each week or more depending on business needs. In many locations, the business will set certain days each week that Flex employees are required to be onsite.

Responsibilities
  1. Be responsible for all Regulatory Affairs strategies for the portfolio and pipeline in Brazil.
  2. Provides strategic and technical input on regulatory requirements to development teams, at regulatory sub teams and to leadership.
  3. Lead assessments of Life Cycle Management changes to provide strategic guidance and expert support to global teams by applying technical knowledge, experience and creative solutions.
  4. Leads all planning, preparation, and execution of regulatory interactions with ANVISA and other agencies in Brazil for select programs.
  5. Represent Brazil Regulatory in sub team meetings, serving as the point of contact for the assigned products, and interfacing with functional areas including Research, Development and Clinical in strategic development for late‑stage products.
  6. Oversees submission processes and leads major applications in Brazil (e.g. MAAs, CTAs, LCM, GMPc).
  7. Lead regulatory partnerships with key stakeholders to deliver innovative strategies, facilitating interactions with local partners/consultants.
  8. Manage preparation of responses to questions to ANSIVA and/or any health authorities in Brazil as well as prepare comments on draft documentation sent out for consultation from the health authority.
  9. Develop and implement regulatory policies, processes, and SOP in Brazil in compliance with Ultragenyx SOPs.
  10. Creates, coordinates and maintains submission schedules and timelines with regulatory operations and the cross functional team, ensuring timely delivery of high‑quality documents.
  11. Keep current with Brazil and relevant Agency guidelines and regulations.
  12. Act as Pharmacovigilance (PV) Deputy in the absence of the Brazilian Pharmacovigilance Responsible, where all PV responsibilities will be delegated to the deputy through a documented handover process.
  13. Contribute to creation of local labels as needed.
  14. Be regulatory partner and lead contribution in Veeva PromoMats process as needed.
  15. Provides supervision and mentoring to junior regulatory professionals on the team, if applicable.
  16. Participate in cross‑functional committees and sub‑teams in accordance with company initiatives, as necessary.
  17. Strategic participation in trade associations meetings such as SINDUSFARMA is required.
Requirements
  1. Pharmacy degree preferred or BA/BS degree in life sciences and 10 years of relevant experience working in Regulatory in the pharmaceutical/ biotech industry. Advanced degree preferred.
  2. The candidate must have hands on experience for at least 5 years with regulatory filings biologics/biotech and specialized therapies in Brazil, as well as preferred experience with Gene Therapies and other compounds for the treatment of rare diseases.
  3. In depth understanding and application of industry standards and international/ ANVISA regulations and guidelines for MAA/CTAs/LCM drug registration processes.
  4. Sound knowledge of global regulatory framework, drug development and post approval requirements including foreign regulations and WHO/ICH is required.
  5. Experience working with high effectiveness and building strong partnerships with key internal and external stakeholders.
  6. Experience in communicating regulatory strategy, submission documents and plans both internally and externally.
  7. The desire and ability to work in a fast‑paced, start‑up environment, eager to learn/apply new skills.
  8. Requires initiative, able to work independently, creative problem‑solving ability, hands‑on willing to work, and excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Spanish is a plus. Please complete your application and submit your CV in English.
  9. Demonstrated ability to strategize, prioritize, contribute to decision‑making and manage with project management skills multiple tasks simultaneously.

A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

  • Otimizar o tempo de preparação e ajuste de máquinas, visando agilizar o processo produtivo e reduzir o tempo ocioso dos equipamentos.
  • Programar, em conjunto com a manutenção, as paradas de máquinas para manutenção, visando otimizar o fluxo de produção e a vida útil dos equipamentos.
  • Orientar, treinar e motivar as equipes de produção, visando alcançar níveis crescentes de produtividade e qualidade.
  • Supervisionar as condições de segurança e higiene na fábrica, visando preservar a integridade física e saúde dos funcionários.
  • Controlar banco de horas, programar férias e controlar ajuste de pontos, mudança de escalas respeitando as diretrizes da companhia.
  • Monitoramento de Headcount, infrações de pontos, absenteísmo, banco de horas e entre outros.

  • Manter o local de trabalho limpo e organizado.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Alper Seguros

A Alper celebra 15 anos de história e se consolida como a quinta maior corretora de seguros do Brasil, um feito que reflete sua Alta Performance em Seguros. Somos especialistas em gestão de Seguros Corporativos, Benefícios, Automóvel, Transportes, Massificados, Agro, Resseguros, Specialty e Seguros Pessoais. Para a Alper, alta performance significa superar continuamente nossos resultados e entregas, sempre com foco naquilo que mais importa: as pessoas.

Com uma proteção 360º abrangente, nossa estratégia e cultura caminham lado a lado. Isso se reflete desde um planejamento sólido até uma liderança engajada em promover um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais inclusivo e diverso. Nossos números demonstram a nossa força: são mais de 1.200 colaboradores, 29 escritórios espalhados pelo país, com matriz em São Paulo, mais de R$6 bilhões em prêmios administrados e mais de 20 mil clientes em diversos segmentos.

Na Alper Seguros, transformar negócios e desenvolver pessoas são diretrizes que se unem e guiam nossos cinco valores: Ser Apaixonado, Descomplicado, Especialista, Empático e Transparente. Eles nos conectam ao nosso propósito: "Entregar para o mercado as mais eficientes soluções de seguros, por meio de relações de confiança". Para impulsionar esse direcionamento, adotamos uma postura consultiva junto aos nossos clientes, internos e externos, oferecendo momentos de desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossos compromisso em proporcionar uma excelente experiência para os colaboradores é reconhecido pelo certificado GPTW, que conquistamos pelo sétimo ano consecutivo, e pela nossa inclusão desde 2024 no Ranking das 175 Melhores Empresas para se Trabalhar no país.

Seu papel é assegurar o alinhamento entre estratégia, operação e cultura, fortalecendo o Concierge como pilar estratégico da Alper, diferencial competitivo e gerador de valor para clientes, RHs contratantes e para o negócio.

  • Vivência na liderança e facilitação de resolução de problemas e / ou estudos de melhoria de processos / automação industrial;

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. Na Auren Energia, acreditamos que o futuro passa por ideias inovadoras, atitudes sustentáveis e um mundo mais positivo; e o que faz a diferença para criar a nossa sinergia é com quem vamos! Tudo o que fazemos só é possível com as pessoas no centro, por isso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos as diferentes formas de contribuir com a criação de um amanhã mais positivo.

Queremos uma Auren ainda mais diversa! Encorajamos que pessoas com deficiência se candidatem, como também mulheres, pessoas LGBT+, pessoas negras e indígenas, de diferentes idades e regiões!

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como Supervisor(a) de Operações e Manutenção para realizar esta atividade nas usinas hidrelétricas, garantindo o uso otimizado de recursos, a mitigação dos riscos operacionais e o bom ambiente de trabalho.

  • Otimizar a performance das plantas com eficiência, qualidade, segurança, sustentabilidade e respeito ao indivíduo.
  • Gerir equipes técnicas, garantindo o atendimento e compliance aos processos internos e aos requisitos de órgãos reguladores
  • Supervisionar, otimizar e realizar a operação e manutenção (preventiva, corretiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos e sistemas das instalações pertencentes aos parques hidraulicos da Auren Energia.
  • Supervisionar e participar de reuniões de planejamento e alinhamento de atividades de O&M objetivando a ciência e o comprometimento de todos com a programação de manutenção e geração, revisões e/ou reparos programados.
  • Garantir alta performance dos ativos através de gestão e plano de ações com base em indicadores de disponibilidade temporal, tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF), tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), dentre outros de mercado ou desenvolvidos pela Auren Energia (KPI's de manutenção).
  • Elaborar e cumprir o orçamento anual de OPEX e CAPEX; Disponibilizar informações para elaboração do planejamento estratégico de 5 anos da área.
  • Responsável pela elaboração/aprovação dos relatórios de O&M e e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais. Garantir a boa fluência e rastreabilidade das informações permeadas na companhia.
  • Responsável pela gestão e acompanhamento das manutenções das Unidades Geradoras e auxiliares, pertencentes as usinas hidrelétricas.
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade dos processos de manutenção por meio da ferramenta SAP/PM.
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos de segurança estabelecidos. Realizar inspeções diárias em seus EPI´s, EPC´s, assim como nos itens de segurança dos veículos, zelar pela segurança de todos os membros da equipe. Identificar desvios comportamentais ou situacionais que coloquem em risco a equipe e reportar para sua liderança. Analisar previamente os riscos da atividade (APR).
  • Supervisionar e realizar manobras dos equipamentos e sistemas das instalações da Subestações (inclusive subestações de Alta Tensão - até 230 kV), sob a coordenação do Centro de Operações (CO- Auren Energia).
  • Participar de metas estratégicas e táticas da área da O&M de forma a garantir o atingimento dos resultados esperados para sua área de atuação.

  • Elétrica/Eletrônica - Banco de Baterias, Retificadores, Sistemas de proteção, alimentadores CC e CA, Sistemas de comunicação.

  • Conhecimento em gestão financeira de OPEX e CAPEX, elaboração de Orçamento e Rolling Forecast da área de O&M.
  • Conhecimentos no sistema SAP - Módulo PM e transações para abertura de processo de compras.
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de pessoas.
A soma da nossa energia com a sua impulsiona pessoas e negócios.

Nosso estratégia de crescimento transformacional nos levou à posição de terceira maior geradora de energia do país, com 8,8 GW de capacidade instalada. Estamos presente em nove estados, com 39 ativos e um portfólio diversificado de fontes eólica, solar e hídrica — que nos coloca entre as líderes na produção de energia 100% renovável.

Com o propósito de gerar resultados admiráveis e um legado positivo para a sociedade, somos guiados pela sustentabilidade, ética e segurança, com foco no bem-estar de nossas pessoas e no impacto positivo para a sociedade.

Geramos resultados que impactam positivamente todo o ecossistema: com grande capacidade de execução e poder de transformação, criamos e compartilhamos valor para surpreender os nossos clientes.

Fortalecemos pessoas e relações: a energia da Auren emana das nossas pessoas, o centro de todas as nossas relações. Ao somar potências e fomentar inclusão e diversidade, nos fortalecemos e nos potencializamos, juntos.

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Supervision of the operation that focuses on delivering orders from Amazon directly to customers;
  • Support your team of operational leaders in the daily management of the delivery station. This will include labor allocation, meeting leadership, assignment of tasks, and communication with internal and external suppliers;

  • Find practical and simple solutions to complex problems without sacrificing quality or core functionality. Utilizing exceptional problem solving and communication skills to influence business and technical audiences;
  • Provide daily support during the implementation/implementation of new systems/processes and collect feedback;
  • Mapping business requirements, understanding business processes, studying and analyzing workflows, and designing solutions;
  • Continuously use software and hardware tools to ensure normal day-to-day operations. Ensure that associates have the appropriate tools to perform the job and coordinate repair or replacement when necessary;
  • Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to other Operations departments and across Amazon as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • Experience in employee and performance management

  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial, em Curitiba/PR.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de governança como Jira e Confluence.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

Quem somos

Procuramos profissionais que queiram trabalhar em uma empresa repleta de desafios, novidades e muito aprendizado! Diferenciais para o cargo:

description:
The Marketing team in Latin America defines and evolves how Spotify shows up across the region. We shape brand experiences that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply rooted in music culture. In Brazil, our work connects artists, fans, and communities through bold storytelling and culturally fluent creative execution.

The Creative Director leads the local Creative and Production teams and is the primary creative decision‑maker for Brazil. It brings local nuance, creative ambition, and strong leadership to marketing initiatives in the market. While focused on Brazil, the role sits within the broader Latin American organization and may contribute to regional projects where local creative leadership is required.

What You’ll Do
  • Own the creative vision for Spotify brand initiatives in Brazil, from strategic concept through final execution
  • Lead and develop local Creative and Production teams, setting clear standards for craft, collaboration, timelines, and budget management
  • Ensure creative excellence across campaigns, content, and experiences — delivering work that is on brief, on budget, and on time
  • Translate global and regional strategies into locally resonant campaigns, social content, video, artist programs, editorial moments, and platform experiences
  • Build and nurture a strong ecosystem of creative partners and vendors, raising the bar on quality, cultural relevance, and execution

Who You Are
  • 8+ years of experience leading creative work within music, culture, entertainment, or adjacent industries
  • You bring deep knowledge of the Brazil market and a strong understanding of its cultural landscape
  • You know how to translate brand and marketing strategy into compelling, original creative ideas
  • You have experience leading multidisciplinary creative and production teams with accountability for quality, cost, and delivery
  • You exercise sound judgment and can make clear decisions when priorities are in tension
  • You collaborate effectively across marketing, partnerships, and global teams
  • You care deeply about craft, cultural authenticity, and inclusive storytelling
  • You thrive in fast‑moving environments and embrace change with focus and clarity
Where You’ll Be
  • This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

description:
O Hospital Veterinário VFP é tido como referência na medicina veterinária intensiva no quesito qualidade e inovação no Brasil com unidades em Ribeirão Preto, Araraquara, São José dos Campos e Uberlândia. Novas unidades serão inauguradas em Uberaba, Franca, Piracicaba e São José do Rio Preto.

♻ Nosso hospital vive sob a cultura de aprendizagem, com valorização de stakeholders e com as melhores tecnologias do mercado para que a assistência médica veterinária seja eficiente.

Se você busca um ambiente inovador e de excelência em medicina veterinária intensiva, venha fazer parte do Hospital VFP!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O(a) Patologista Clínico(a) Veterinário(a) desempenha um papel essencial no diagnóstico, acompanhamento e monitoramento de doenças em animais, atuando principalmente em laboratórios e hospitais veterinários. Sua atuação é fundamental para garantir diagnósticos precisos e contribuir com o plano terapêutico dos pacientes atendidos pelo corpo clínico.

1. Análise de Amostras Biológicas
  • Hematologia: Realizar hemogramas completos para avaliar a saúde das células sanguíneas (hemácias, leucócitos e plaquetas); identificar anemias, infecções e outras alterações hematológicas.
  • Bioquímica Clínica: Analisar substâncias químicas no sangue (enzimas, eletrólitos, proteínas, entre outros) para avaliar a função de órgãos como fígado, rins e pâncreas.
  • Urinálise: Examinar amostras de urina para detectar infecções urinárias, doenças renais e alterações metabólicas.
  • Análise de Fluidos Corporais: Realizar exames em líquido cefalorraquidiano, líquido sinovial e efusões cavitárias, auxiliando no diagnóstico diferencial de diversas doenças.
  • Citologia: Examinar amostras celulares obtidas por punções ou raspados, para diagnóstico de processos inflamatórios, infecciosos ou neoplásicos.
  • Microbiologia: Realizar cultivos e testes microbiológicos para identificar bactérias e outros microrganismos causadores de infecções.
  • Imunologia: Executar testes imunológicos para detecção de doenças infecciosas, mensuração de níveis de anticorpos e avaliação de respostas imunes.

Interpretação de Resultados: Correlacionar os resultados laboratoriais com os sinais clínicos e histórico do paciente; elaborar laudos diagnósticos claros, completos e precisos, auxiliando o médico veterinário clínico na tomada de decisão terapêutica.

3. Colaboração com o Corpo Clínico

Oferecer suporte técnico a outros médicos veterinários, auxiliando na interpretação de resultados e indicação de exames complementares; participar de discussões clínicas e reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a definição de condutas diagnósticas e terapêuticas.

Controle de Qualidade e Rotina Laboratorial
  • Assegurar a precisão e a qualidade dos exames laboratoriais, seguindo protocolos e normas técnicas estabelecidas.
  • Realizar a manutenção e calibração periódica dos equipamentos laboratoriais.
  • Manter o ambiente de trabalho organizado e em conformidade com normas de biossegurança.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Medicina Veterinária.
  • Pós-graduação e/ou residência em Patologia Clínica Veterinária.
  • Registro ativo no CRMV.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em laboratório clínico veterinário ou hospital de ensino.
Informações adicionais
  • Domínio das técnicas laboratoriais em hematologia, bioquímica, citologia e urinálise.
  • Capacidade de elaborar laudos técnicos detalhados e embasados cientificamente.

title: Head of Partnerships, Brazil
description:
Location: São Paulo (remote working)

Substack is building a new global economic engine for culture, giving the most creative and interesting people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack’s model—based on direct subscriptions—has fueled an explosion of independent publishing, empowering creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences.

We’re hiring a Head of Partnerships for Brazil to lead and scale the Brazilian Substack business. Working alongside our Head of International, you’ll be responsible for building awareness of the Substack brand in Brazil, onboarding the country’s most exciting independent talent, and helping to tell the Substack story to creators and consumers across the country. This is a pivotal role for an exceptional leader who has a strong track record of business growth and nurturing creative talent across all mediums. You’ll also be a strategic thinker comfortable working with both high‑profile political figures and emerging creators. Knowledge of events and the ability to speak publicly are a bonus.

What You’ll Do:
  • Develop and execute a strategy for onboarding influential creators with assistance from Substack’s Head of International, helping them build successful subscription businesses and vibrant communities on Substack.
  • Own key growth metrics around creator acquisition, retention, revenue, and engagement—aligning impact with Substack’s broader business goals.
  • Build and deepen relationships with creators, talent managers, studios, agencies, tastemakers, and the press to expand Substack’s presence in the cultural ecosystem.
  • Champion Brazilian creators internally by synthesizing their needs, motivations, and ambitions into product, support, and partnership opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Product, Data, Marketing, and Communications to evolve the Portuguese creator experience and improve outreach and feature adoption.
  • Represent Substack externally—on stage, in the press, and in key industry rooms—positioning the company as the premier platform for independent creative work.
  • Stay ahead of creator economy trends, emerging formats, and shifting audience behaviors to keep Substack on the leading edge in Brazil.
What We’re Looking For:
  • 7+ years of experience as a leader in creator partnerships, talent development, business development, or editorial.
  • Proven success leading and scaling teams in fast‑paced environments with high agency and ownership.
  • Deep empathy for creators and an understanding of the challenges and opportunities they face when building independent careers.
  • A robust network across the creator economy—including relationships with top creators, talent agencies, production companies, digital media leaders, and journalists.
  • A demonstrable and exceptional understanding of the Brazilian ‘creator’ market.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, often on a public stage, is a bonus.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market‑competitive salary, equity for all full‑time roles, and exceptional benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

title: Director
description:
Native Pet is re-imagining pet nutrition for a new generation of pet parents. We make dog-approved supplements to help consumers nourish their pets. Our clean-label products, developed with leading veterinary nutritionists, leverage whole food and superfood ingredients backed by clinical research to deliver real, functional health benefits. We are in high growth mode as we scale across the digital and retail landscapes. Our ambition is to be the global leader in the pet consumables category.

Role Overview

Native Pet is seeking a Head of AI Automation to lead the technical strategy and execution of our internal efficiency initiatives. This is a high-impact full-stack engineering role working directly with the CEO to modernize how our business operates. This role is "hands-on keyboard," meaning you will be accountable for leading the strategy while also executing the development.

You will be responsible for architecting and building automated systems that support our core business functions—Marketing, Product Innovation, Operations, and Finance. Your objective is to leverage Artificial Intelligence and automation tools to reduce manual workload, improve data accuracy, and accelerate decision-making across the company.

This is a fully remote, work-from-home position open to candidates working within approved North and South American time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise-Wide Automation - You will collaborate with various business functions to develop tools and automations, leveraging AI and automation to enhance efficiency and productivity across the organization. This initiative aims to help us achieve more with fewer resources. Example project types may include:

  • Marketing & Growth: Automate complex workflows such as automated competitor research, programmatic paid media content generation, and personalized customer communication based on purchasing behavior.
  • Finance & Operations: Streamline back-office functions, including automated invoice processing, real-time inventory alerts, and synchronizing data between our supply chain and financial reporting tools.
  • Product Innovation: Accelerate R&D by building tools that can aggregate and summarize research data, analyze market trends, and organize product formulation notes.
Data Architecture & Contextual AI

Collaborate with the data team to scale our data pipelines and architecture for AI tools. Crucially, utilize our proprietary data to build context and enhance the effectiveness of our AI applications.

  • Unified Data Syncing: Design and maintain pipelines that sync data from disparate sources (Shopify, ERP, Marketing Platforms) into a centralized architecture.
  • Query-Ready Infrastructure: Ensure internal data is structured, clean, and tagged effectively, making it easy for both AI agents and human analysts to query our own data for real-time insights.
  • Knowledge Retrieval: Build systems that allow LLMs to accurately access proprietary company data (documents, historical performance) without hallucinations.
Systems Architecture & Internal Tools

Oversee the development and maintenance of internal tools to guarantee consistency, functionality, ease of access, and collaborative use across all teams and personnel.

  • Custom Interfaces: Develop lightweight, user-friendly web applications (using tools like Streamlit, Retool, or React) that allow non-technical staff to utilize AI workflows.
  • Reliability: Monitor the health of automated workflows to ensure they run reliably and securely.
Technical Requirements

We are looking for a pragmatic engineer who prioritizes business value over complexity.

  • Workflow Orchestration: Deep expertise in automation and orchestration is required. Whether you prefer n8n, Make, Airflow, or custom Python scripts, you must be capable of architecting complex, branching workflows with robust error handling.
  • AI Integration: Experience working with Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic) via API. You should understand how to structure data and prompts to get consistent, reliable outputs for business tasks.
  • Data Engineering: Proficiency in SQL and JSON manipulation. You must be comfortable structuring data for use in financial and operational reporting.
Candidate Profile
  • Business-First Mindset: You understand that code is a means to an end. You evaluate every project based on the time it saves or the value it creates for the business.
  • Cross-Functional Fluency: You can speak "Marketing" with the Growth team and "Margins" with the Finance team, translating their needs into technical solutions.
  • Rapid Prototyping: You are comfortable using AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code) to accelerate development and deployment.
  • Detail-Oriented: When dealing with financial or inventory data, you understand that accuracy is paramount. You build verification steps into your workflows to ensure data integrity

description:
Com 125 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

title: IT Software Engineer - Senior
description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agro-science Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in‑vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description Basic Function and Scope of Responsibility:

The Software Engineer is primarily responsible for designing, developing, configuring and supporting computer software applications.

Essential Job Duties:
  • Manage designated technology application portfolio from reengineering, enhancements and upgrades, to maintenance and monitoring
  • Provide analysis, architectural design and leadership on large complex projects
  • Work within and assist with management of defined IT processes and procedures including the company’s internal software development life cycle methodology (SDLC)
  • Work with little to no supervision with extreme latitude for independent judgment
  • Consult with senior peers on large complexity projects
  • Proficient in all levels and phases of application development and support
Qualifications

Since this is an international environment; please, make sure you submit your CV English. We will, otherwise, be unable to consider your application.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Level I - Minimum

  • 7+ years of successful application & system development and management; database experience utilizing the .NET Framework
  • Proven experience leading tasks or projects related to large size software implementations
  • Experience using and applying System Development Lifecycle Methodologies
  • Proven experience leading tasks or projects related to medium to large size software implementations
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business or equivalent experience and training
  • Analytical, motivated and ability to learn new technologies and applications
  • Ability to multi‑task
  • Knowledge and management of System Development Lifecycle Methodologies a plus
  • Goal oriented, with excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with ability to interact effectively and work efficiently with people at all levels in an organization
  • Ability to communicate clearly and fluently in English (written and spoken).
  • Keenly attentive to detail
  • Ability to keep sensitive information confidential
Preferred Experience:
  • SQL Server or Oracle
  • Leading projects, developing and administrating Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS): STARLiMS, Harvest, Copia
  • Leading projects, developing and administrating Specimen Management Systems
  • Leading projects, developing and administrating Lab Instrument Interfaces connecting instruments to LIMS
  • Working knowledge of HL7 standard and coding
  • Knowledge of testing laboratory operations and processes a plus
  • Corepoint
  • Developing and administrating ERP and CRM or other software systems: GreatPlains, SalesForce, Carevoyant
  • High level of proficiency with PC based software programs; including project management tools, MS Project
Physical Requirements:
  • Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate a keyboard and other office equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead
  • Ability to speak and hear well enough to communicate clearly and understandably with sufficient volume to ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting
  • Ability to continuously operate a personal computer for extended periods of time (4 or more hours)
  • Mental acuity sufficient to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, make valid judgments and decisions
Additional Information

Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English.

title: Head of Product – Payments Growth
description:
Why should you join dLocal? dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest‑growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer‑centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

About dLocal

dLocal is a leading fintech company that enables global merchants to connect with emerging markets through a single integration. We are on a mission to make global payments seamless and accessible, empowering businesses to grow in complex markets. As we expand our footprint across Latin America, Africa, and Asia, we are doubling down on building world‑class payment products that unlock massive growth opportunities for our merchants.

Role Overview

As the Head of Product – Payments Growth, you will report directly to the VP of Product and be responsible for the full strategy, roadmap, and performance of dLocal’s key payment method portfolio. You will define how dLocal becomes the undisputed leader in next‑generation payment experiences in emerging markets—driving adoption, performance, and revenue growth for our merchants.

You will lead a team of product managers, collaborate closely with engineering, design, risk, finance, and commercial teams across regions, and build strong relationships with external partners (banks, PSPs, APM players, card schemes, BNPL providers, and regulators). Your mission is to create category‑leading products that deliver exceptional conversion, reliability, and user experience—while navigating the unique regulatory, operational, and market dynamics of emerging economies.

This is a high‑visibility, high‑impact role ideal for a strategic thinker who combines deep payments expertise with execution excellence and an entrepreneurial mindset.

You Will
  • Define and communicate a compelling vision for Payments Growth at dLocal, turning emerging payment trends into scalable products for global merchants
  • Build and own the multi‑year strategy for key payment methods (BNPL, Virtual Accounts, Physical Payments, and others), ensuring they become best‑in‑class solutions in emerging markets
  • Identify new payment opportunities and lead the creation of innovative products that expand dLocal’s market leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of product managers focused on individual payment methods and growth areas
  • Define clear goals, KPIs, and success metrics for each payment product, ensuring strong performance across availability, conversion, cost efficiency, and revenue
  • Drive the entire product lifecycle—from ideation to launch, scaling, iteration, and continuous optimization
  • Work closely with engineering, compliance, commercial, and operations to deliver reliable, scalable, and frictionless payment solutions
  • Build strong partnerships with external stakeholders, including customers, banks, BNPL providers, processors, and alternative payment method partners
You Have
  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with at least 4+ years in payments, financial services, or fintech—ideally owning specific payment method products (BNPL, card acquiring, APMs, wallets, cash‑based payments, or bank transfer rails)
  • Proven track record of building and scaling payment products in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments
  • Strong leadership experience, including leading product managers and cross‑functional teams
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and the ability to translate long‑term vision into actionable roadmaps
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication; Spanish is a plus
What do we offer?
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever‑evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
Flexibility in how you work:

We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, LinkedIn and YouTube for more about dLocal!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
