title: Cloud & DevOps Engineering, Principal
description:
WHO WE ARE

Seagull Software, LLC, is a global leader in real-time, item-level visibility and label management solutions, dedicated to powering the world’s most complex supply chains with innovative tools for traceability, authentication, and automated inventory management. Our BarTender platform enables businesses across all industries to design, manage, print, and automate the production of labels, barcodes, and RFID tags, ensuring seamless tracking and compliance for over 100 billion unique identifiers each year. Leveraging the Mojix high-security, scalable SaaS traceability platform, Seagull delivers end-to-end intelligence, harmonizing data to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and reduce risk. Learn more at

We’re a growing, profitable, mid-size business with a 40-year history of leading in our field. Headquartered in Redmond, Washington, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia, Seagull empowers businesses worldwide to keep their products moving, traceable, and safe. You’ll work with global, talented, and diverse teams, passionate about what they do and its impact on everyone, everywhere. Join us and help shape the way the world works.

LOCATION

This direct contractor position is remote in Brazil or LATAM.

JOB SUMMARY

The Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal leads the operations functions responsible for the architecture, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of our multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. This role manages a team of CloudOps and DevOps engineers, defines operating standards, and partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Security to ensure our platforms are secure, scalable, and highly available.

This role supports the execution of the broader CloudOps and DevOps strategy , helping to translate high-level direction into concrete operational practices for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and release management.

The role also contributes to the governance and continuous improvement of build and release processes across SaaS and on-premise environments, in alignment with CloudOps leadership.

The role is deeply embedded in product development, overseeing the operational impact of new features end-to-end, from architectural design and delivery workflows to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. This position safeguards the long-term health of the platform by ensuring that new capabilities align with established business processes, preserve performance at scale, and follow a clear, predictable, and repeatable development lifecycle across SaaS and on-premise environments, in close partnership with CloudOps, DevOps and Engineering leadership.

As a Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal, you will shape the roadmap for Cloud and DevOps operations, drive best practices for Kubernetes, observability, automation, and disaster recovery, and use data and metrics to continuously improve our services. You remain technically strong and able to dive into details when needed, while focusing much of your time on team leadership, coordination, and cross-functional collaboration.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the CloudOps and DevOps teams, setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional development.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for complex, high-impact technical and operational issues affecting customers, the platform, or internal teams.
  • Lead incident response and triage efforts, including customer-facing escalations and platform outages, providing clear technical direction, decision-making, and communication throughout the lifecycle of an incident.
  • Coordinate team priorities, workload distribution, and on-call coverage to ensure consistent operational readiness and resilience.
  • Drive CloudOps and DevOps strategy and roadmap in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives.
  • Actively participate in the product development lifecycle, capturing and validating deployment requirements, operational constraints, risks, and runbook considerations for new features and platform changes.
  • Raise the bar for organizational excellence by enforcing high standards for availability, performance, security, and compliance, ensuring CloudOps and DevOps practices meet or exceed defined SLA and security requirements.
  • Partner with CloudOps and DevOps leadership to define, evolve, and reinforce operational standards across change management, release processes, and incident response.

Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the architecture, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency of platform infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, leveraging native cloud services while maintaining consistent operational principles.
  • Own and evolve governance standards for the use of core cloud services, defining secure, repeatable, and compliant architectural patterns across all environments.
  • Ensure all environments are properly monitored, secured, and operationally aligned with product and customer requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership and operational guidance for multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud strategies, balancing flexibility, resilience, and cost.
  • Maintain direct ownership and involvement in the platform’s on-premise footprint, including Windows-based desktop and server components, ensuring first-class build, packaging, and installer experiences for Windows users.
  • Define and enforce the full software lifecycle for on-premise and desktop applications, from build pipelines and release artifacts to deployment, upgrade, and supportability considerations.
  • Ensure cloud-native infrastructure designs remain compatible with closed and restricted on-premise deployments, preserving portability, operational feasibility, and customer autonomy.
  • Drive continuous improvements to infrastructure design that support both highly scalable cloud deployments and secure, self-contained on-premise installations.

Kubernetes Orchestration & Automation

  • Lead day-to-day infrastructure and application-level operations, with deep hands-on involvement in Kubernetes platforms (EKS, GKE, AKS), serverless workloads, and cloud-native infrastructure, enforcing the highest standards of availability and resilience.
  • Own and oversee Kubernetes operations end-to-end, including cluster lifecycle management, capacity planning, upgrades, and workload reliability.
  • Govern all networking, connectivity, and security-adjacent infrastructure, including ingress controllers, service mesh, gateways, firewalls, VPNs, and inter-environment connectivity.
  • Drive a strong automation-first culture across the CloudOps organization, enforcing standardization and repeatability through infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices.
  • Lead and evolve automation pipelines using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, Helm, and Ansible, ensuring consistency across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Define and enforce standardized deployment strategies, including rolling updates and blue/green rollouts, to minimize operational risk and service disruption.
  • Establish and rigorously apply change management procedures for infrastructure and application changes, reducing release risk while maintaining delivery velocity.
  • Promote continuous improvement and upskilling in Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including structured learning paths and certifications where appropriate.

Monitoring, Alerting & Optimization

  • Own monitoring/observability with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.
  • Define and refine SLOs, alerts, and performance metrics.
  • Use metrics and incidents to drive preventive improvements.
  • Track/report key CloudOps and DevOps KPIs (uptime, MTTR, change failure rate, deployment frequency).

Database & Data Platform Management

  • Guide production MongoDB, Redis, MySQL operations (scale, backup, failover, performance).
  • Ensure databases are monitored, secure, and well integrated.
  • Work with data/app teams on capacity and growth planning for DBs and caches.

Security & Compliance

  • Champion secure cloud practices (RBAC, encryption, segmentation, audits).
  • Oversee SSO and identity federation (OAuth, SAML, OIDC).
  • Support Security/Compliance to meet required standards.
  • Assist with security assessments/audits, remediation, and process improvements.

Automation, CI/CD & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Promote infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc.).
  • Partner with DevOps/engineering on reliable, auditable CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive reuse of automation for provisioning, deployment, and configuration.
  • Support CI/CD and release governance, ensuring agreed quality/security/rollback controls for SaaS and on-prem.

Networking & Traffic Management

  • Oversee cloud networking (VPCs, subnets, NAT, target groups, ACLs).
  • Guide service mesh and traffic management for microservices.
  • Help standardize network patterns and connectivity across cloud, data centers, and partners.

Cost Management & Capacity Planning

  • Monitor and optimize cloud costs with Finance and Product/Engineering.
  • Use tagging/reporting to attribute spend by product or environment.
  • Collaborate on capacity planning as usage and customers grow.
  • Provide cost/capacity summaries to leadership with trends, risks, and optimizations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Act as a key CloudOps and DevOps partner for Product, DevOps, SRE, Security, and IT.
  • Join planning to align CloudOps and DevOps initiatives with product and company priorities.
  • Communicate clearly on platform health, risks, incidents, and improvements.
  • Serve as an operational escalation point for major incidents/releases, coordinating resolution and follow-up with leadership and partner teams.

WHAT WE REQUIRE

Experience and skills:

  • 8–10+ years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or SRE roles, including formal leadership of engineers or small teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure, GCP (GKE, Load Balancers, Cloud Run, App Engine, BigQuery) and AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, Route 53, security groups, etc.).
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes operations, containerized microservices, and tooling (EKS, GKE, Helm, etc.).
  • Proven experience managing well known, production-grade, monitoring/observability frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and defining SLOs and alerting.
  • Advanced knowledge of MongoDB (Sharded Clusters), Redis, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kafka and MySQL administration in production environments.
  • Strong skills in Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Ansible, and CI/CD practices for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Solid understanding of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, identity federation, and secure infrastructure design.
  • Demonstrated ability to use operational and reliability metrics to guide improvements in cloud operations.
  • Experience working with or supporting multi-cloud and/or hybrid-cloud environments, providing operational input on performance, risk, and feasibility.
  • Experience tracking and reporting CloudOps/DevOps KPIs (e.g., uptime, MTTR, deployment frequency, change failure rate) to support continuous improvement.

Proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Soft skills:
  • Strong leadership and people development capabilities
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to break down complex problems
  • Detail-oriented, results-driven, and passionate about system reliability
  • Clear communicator across technical and business teams
  • Passion for working and learning in a fast-growing company.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in agile and cross-functional environments to achieve common goals.
  • Proactive learning new technologies, industry trends, and adapting to evolving tools and methodologies.
EDUCATION
  • Bachelor's Degree in related fields such as: Bachelor’s Degree, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Related technical field.
  • Certifications as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, or GCP DevOps Engineer, are a plus.
  • Master’s Degree: Specializations in Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, or Software, are a plus.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT
This is a full-time Contractor position.

OUR CULTURE

We offer a dynamic, culturally diverse, and fun environment where people with energy, creativity, and passion work together to deliver amazing product experiences for our customers. Join a team where your background is valued and respected, and your unique insights and ideas contribute to building a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga
  • Homogenizar a amostra coletada e realiza a classificação das amostras conforme manual de classificação da LDC, apontando o limite da percentagem de cada item de classificação (umidade, impureza, avariados, grãos verdes, ardidos, queimados e quebrados);
  • Monitorar via supervisório e em campo as variáveis de processo, controlar cargas, amperagens, temperaturas, depressões e níveis, para realizar de forma segura o processo de secagem de graõs;

  • Acompanhar a temperatura dos secadores e realizar abastecimento das fornalhas com lenha, quando necessário;

  • Monitorar a temperatura do produto estocado nos armazéns, gerar relatórios de termometria para analisar a necessidade de forçar aeração ou remoção dos grãos e tomar as devidas providências, informando o Supervisor de Armazenagem e Gerência quando necessário;
  • Monitorar o processo de limpeza da soja, regulando cargas nas peneiras, limpeza nas telas do equipamento;
  • Acompanhar o abastecimento dos armazéns, controlar os pontos de entrada e retirada de produto, para evitar derramamentos e remoção de pontos indevidos;
  • Manter a área de trabalho limpa e organizada, seguindo as Instruções de Trabalho, cronogramas de limpeza e demais orientações dos programas implantados na unidade;
  • Monitorar os pontos de controle, realizar corretamente o preenchimento das planilhas, tomando as providências necessárias e informando ao Supervisor quando necessário;
  • Empurrar produtos no armazém para as bicas de saída utilizando a pá carregadeira;
  • Acompanhar o levantamento e auxiliar a execução das manutenções, preventivas e corretivas para minimizar as quebras dos equipamentos e conservação das estruturas físicas;
  • Realizar bloqueio e sinalização de equipamentos conforme as diretrizes do programa LOTO (Lockout/Tagout), após treinamento específico, quando solicitado pela gestão imediata;
  • Auxiliar na organização de equipes para realização de atividades diárias e treinamentos técnicos do setor;
  • Trabalhar de acordo com as Políticas e Normas da Cia, atendendo as determinações do Sistema de Gestão SHE (Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente), Procedimentos Locais e Divisionais e realizando inspeções de segurança no próprio setor, com o objetivo de evitar a ocorrência de acidentes;

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa.

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency.

Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.

Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

title: Global Business Process Owner - Request to Pay
description:
Global Business Process Owner - Request to Pay

Job Reference JR

Professional Areas: Strategic Planning & Development

Louis Dreyfus Company is a leading merchant and processor of agricultural goods. Our activities span the entire value chain from farm to fork, across a broad range of business lines. We leverage our global reach and extensive asset network to serve our customers and consumers around the world. Structured as a matrix organization of six geographical regions and ten platforms, Louis Dreyfus Company is active in over 100 countries and employs approximately 18,000 people globally.

Job Description

As LDC continues to grow, to standardize operating processes and to modernize its systems front to back-implementing a proprietary CTRM integrated with SAP S4 HANA as main back office system, we are looking for a Global business Process owner for End to End Request to Pay processes.

Starting from existing core model framework, the GPO R2P is responsible for designing, implementing, owning and improving the end‑to‑end R2P process across functional areas, geographies and business boundaries, as part of the SBS organization. The GPO will be partnering closely with key stakeholders across the supported corporate functions (Industry, Procurement and Finance) as well as within the SBS organization (Master Data, continuous improvement, service operations across centers, etc…)

The aim of the role is to drive the design, implementation, integration and optimization across the end‑to‑end value chain (master data; purchase requisitions, purchase orders, good receipts, invoice capture, invoice processing, invoice settlement, resolution, of global R2P processes, etc), so as to provide services to circa 260 industrial plants across the world.

The GPO R2P ensures alignment with business goals, manages risks, and leads process transformation initiatives.

In this role you will be responsible for:
  • Process design and implementation: Translates functions strategy and policies into global processes and lead the transformation.
  • Performance management: Define performance KPIs and targets in collaboration with functions to measure process performance.
  • Governance: Govern the process E2E (As-Is, To‑Be, and all variations), ensuring design decisions are aligned to the process objectives and functional strategy.
  • Leadership and directions: Lead a team of process owners responsible for the design, implementation and optimization of global R2P process. Influence the organization through mentoring and change management capabilities.
  • Stakeholders’ management: Drive stakeholder engagement and stakeholder satisfaction through identifying value‑add and continuous improvement opportunities aligned with stakeholders’ challenges and priorities.
  • Problem solving / Operational issues: Work closely with other functions (e.g. Accounting, Procurement, Finance, Platforms, etc.) to proactively manage and resolve business and operational issues in an innovative, efficient and effective manner.
  • Business Relationship Management and change management: Partner with the Head of Procurement, the Head of Accounting and the head of Industry to align on improvements to the Request to Pay service levels.
  • Technology enablement: Act as forward thinkers, collaborate with the functions and DT&A (IT) to propose enabling solution and business cases for budget prioritization.

The ideal candidate will have 10+ years’ experience in Business R2P with at least 2 years of experience in project management in a global enterprise environment.

Diversity & Inclusion

LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.

LDC encourages diversity, supports local communities and environmental initiatives. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

Sustainability

Sustainable value is at the heart of our purpose as a company.

We are passionate about creating fair and sustainable value, both for our business and for other value chain stakeholders: our people, our business partners, the communities we touch and the environment around us.

Position: General Manager

Do you love premium Coffee & Tea? Do you want to work for a socially responsible, guest service driven company? The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® General Managercurates memorable experiences for our guests and the CBTL team daily.We are seeking friendly, dedicated, and creative Barista’s to provide our guests with the world’s finest quality coffee and tea experience. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to engage with the clients while developing your skills in a variety of areas across the business. Many of our General Managers started off as Baristas!

If you are looking for an opportunity where you can be yourself and have fun doing it, while creating a base of loyal CBTL fans out of the local community, we want to talk to you about joining our growing and diverse team.

Day in the Life:
  • Lead by example. General Manager is a leader/advocate for your team by driving profitability, service, performance, and operational excellence through coaching and training.
  • Be a coffee & tea expert. You bring the passion, we provide the training, and you share it with the team and guests providing aTotal Quality Experience.
  • Generate new guests. Many guests shop online these days; however, the store is where we meet many of our guests for the first time.
  • Care about safety. Safe store environment, healthy employees and guests are our number one priority.
  • Contribute. General Manager to manage a profitable store by tracking sales and overseeing the day to day operations and risk management. Help the store with tasks, ideas and support store growth operationally.
  • Be Creative. Visual merchandising and product placement to create memorable experiences for the guests.
  • Be an advocate. As the face of CBTL you will build the store presence by connecting with your local community to attract & retain fresh talent.
  • Be a Mentor. General Manager will mentor an Assistant General Manager as well as other store staff by knowledge sharing and embodying CBTL guiding principles.
  • At The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, we hire for our core values Friendliness / Respect / Ownership / Teamwork / Honesty — FROTH and identify team members who share these values.

About Us:

Born and brewed in Southern California since 1963, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® has become one of the world’s largest independent and privately-owned specialty coffee and tea retailers. In 1963 we opened our very first store in Brentwood, California. Today we have over 1100 stores in 31 countries as well as regional offices in Singapore and Malaysia. We have always had a creative and caring spirit. This energy embodied by our Team Members made us famous and beloved by our guests, first in Southern California and now around the world. We are a brand centered around passion. A passion for our premium products, our people, the guests and everyone we work with around the world. Passion is contagious, and we’ve got a serious case of it.

Our Products:

We’re known for an unwavering commitment to premium quality coffee and tea and have built direct supplier relationships with the best private coffee farms and tea estates around the world. We select only the top 1% of Arabica beans and the finest hand plucked, whole leaf tea. All our coffee and tea blends are developed at our state-of-the-art facility in Camarillo, CA – giving us total control, for ultimate precision. Once perfected, our beverages are then prepared locally for maximum freshness. We are constantly seeking out new trending flavors, innovative development methodologies and cultural flavor influences. Over the years we have come up with breakthrough beverages like The Original Ice Blended drink, introduced back in 1989, before frozen coffee was a craze, or the Tea Latte. We are always looking to formulate the next fan favorite, making our menu ever-changing and always improving.

Social Responsibility:

We believe we are in business for more than making a profit. We want to make a difference. We have always done it this way. Back in the day, Herb Hyman, our founder, advocated for coffee growers and exporters, paying higher prices to help them grow their business. Today we are making a difference at every step of the way, from the communities we source from, to our Team Members in stores, to building a brighter future through investing in our Caring Cup Program. Our genuine care is evident from seed to cup. It’s why our guests feel comfortable to be themselves and why we are serving so much more than a great cup of coffee or tea.
